prompt.text:
Write a new implementation in `solution.rs` for canonical configuration lookup.

Expose this exact API:

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum LookupError { EmptyKey, MalformedEntry { index: usize }, ConflictingValues }
pub fn lookup_setting(entries: &[(String, String)], key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, LookupError>;
```

Trim ASCII whitespace from the lookup key. Return `EmptyKey` if it becomes empty. Entry keys are malformed if they are empty after ASCII trimming or contain ASCII control characters; validate every entry in order even when an earlier entry matches, and report the first malformed index.

Compare trimmed entry keys to the trimmed lookup key using ASCII case-insensitive comparison. Trim ASCII whitespace from matched values. The first match determines output ordering. Later matches with the same trimmed value are permitted; a later match with a different trimmed value returns `ConflictingValues`. Values may be empty. If no entry matches, return `Ok(None)`. Otherwise return an owned copy in `Some`. Do not mutate the entries or key.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
